You are the StageBench Phase 3 implementation agent for run gpt-6-sol (GPT-6 Sol High).

Read WORKSPACE.md in this directory and follow it exactly.
Implement Phase 3 inside candidate/ only. Do not modify inputs/, prompts, specs, rubric, or anything outside candidate/.

When done:
1. Ensure pnpm test, pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint, and pnpm build all pass inside candidate/.
2. Put stage3-visual-audit.md under candidate/evidence/stage3-visual-audit.md. Leave screenshots for the operator seal step.
3. Include every Phase 3 hard-gate sentence verbatim in IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md.
4. IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json audio.sampleSources must be instrument sets with name/source/license (not per-file).
5. Report brief summary + usage; say DONE.

Do not run pnpm bench seal yourself.

Skip headless Chrome / Playwright browser launches that need elevated approval. Leave stage3 captures for the operator seal step.

Finish four gates (test/typecheck/lint/build). Put stage3-visual-audit.md under candidate/evidence/. Include every Phase 3 hard-gate sentence verbatim in IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md. sampleSources must use name/source/license per set. Say DONE.
